newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases as investors offload.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases as investors offload.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased marginally on Monday as investors offloaded shares of selected companies after reaping dividend benefits in a dull trading session, brokers said.
The index lost 2.55 points to close at 3377.87. Turnover was posted at 15.8 million shillings on 424,800 shares compared to 23.4 million shillings on 2,395,661 shares on Friday.
Barclays Bank was the greatest decline, losing 6.0 to close at 106. It traded without a final dividend of 7.0, while Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 94 from 95.
Kenya Power & Lighting shed 3.0 to close at 112 while Sasini Tea & Coffee closed at 75 from 75.50.

Brokers said investors whose attention early this year focused on speculative buying ahead of year-end results shifted to the initial public share offering of luxury hotel chain Serena Lodges & Hotels.
"A lot of them were selling to buy bonds and Serena shares," a broker said. The offer is open March 24 to April 14.
East African Development Bank EADB.NR traded five million shillings at 102.06 percent from 101.90 percent on March 14.
Bourse officials said slow trading characterised business on the remaining shares. Uchumi Supermarket was unchanged at 36.25 while Kenya Airways closed at 8.60 from 8.55.
Lonrho Motors edged a shilling to close at 206 from 205. Kenya Breweries was unchanged at 58 while Kenya National Mills closed at 38.25 from 36.
